name: Ride A Cart Down A Slide
desc:
Welcome to Ride A Cart Down A Slide!

How to play:
- 🚗 Ride your cart to gain distance
- 💰 Use this distance to buy more carts 
- 💲 Reach the end for a distance multiplier!
- 💣 Use the gun to explode other carts!

🎁Like the game for updates and future rewards!
